definitions.explanation: Having many functions or superior capabilities. Used to describe products, devices, software, or materials that offer advanced features beyond basic models.

examples.japanese: {高機能|こうきのう}な⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高機能|こうきのう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{軽量|けいりょう}→軽量：19124_keiryou⟧だ。
examples.english: This material is high-performance and lightweight.

examples.japanese: {高機能|こうきのう}な⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{使|つか}いこなす→使いこなす：07179_tsukaikonasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: High-tech appliances are convenient, but it can take time to master them.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a prefix or adjective-like modifier with な. Very common in product descriptions, technology reviews, and advertising. Often contrasted with {低機能|ていきのう} (low-function) or ⟦{多機能|たきのう}→多機能：18683_takinou⟧ (multi-function).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高機能|こうきのう}⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧ (high-performance material)
- {高機能|こうきのう}⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧ (high-tech home appliances)
- {高機能|こうきのう}な⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧ (sophisticated product)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{多機能|たきのう}→多機能：18683_takinou⟧: multi-functional — emphasizes having many functions, while {高機能|こうきのう} emphasizes the quality or level of functionality
